title: codeart2d contracts
description: Frozen contracts, version 1, for code-authored art: PixelSpec, rig animation, FX specs, material specs and the codeart-meta.json that discloses art_source code. codeart2d frames and tiles then use the sprite and map contracts. The PixelSpec $defs describe the form codeart_core.render_pixelspec reads; validate a spec against them before rendering. Objects stay open (additionalProperties true).

pixelspecColor.description: A PixelSpec colour as codeart_core.hex_to_rgba reads it: an optional '#', then 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa). Alpha 0 marks an erasing entry that clears lower layers. Write #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa; the short and '#'-less spellings are accepted for hand-written specs.

charPalette.description: Palette keyed by single characters. '.' and space are reserved for transparency; an alpha-0 colour (#rrggbb00) marks an erasing entry. Used for PixelSpec variants, which may be empty and override base colours only.

pixelspecPalette.description: The base palette of a PixelSpec: at least one single-character key other than '.' or space. Digit keys work in rows but not in segments, where digits are run counts.

pixelRows.description: Pixel rows, top to bottom; each character is a palette key, '.' or space.

pixelSegments.description: Run-length pixel rows, top to bottom, for wide art (recommended above 64 px): each row is a sequence of an optional run count (at least 1) followed by one character, so '13.6l13.' is 13 '.', 6 'l' and 13 '.'. Digits are counts, so segment rows cannot use digit palette characters.

pixelGrid.description: A pose: literal rows, {rows: [...]} or {segments: [...]}. An object with both rows and segments is refused as ambiguous.

pixelLayer.description: A layer placed at origin [x, y] (default [0, 0]) and composited by z (lower first, default 0, ties keep list order); the pixels a layer paints replace those below. rows is a pose name or literal rows; segments hold run-length rows (segments win when both are given). A layer without rows or segments must be hidden or get them from every frame it is rendered in. mirror flips the layer; mirror_safe false keeps asymmetric gear (emblems, text) unflipped when a frame sets flip_x; hidden skips the layer.

pixelFrame.description: A frame: integer dx/dy shift every layer, flip_x mirrors every layer's placement (layers with mirror_safe false keep their orientation), and layers holds per-layer overrides for layers the spec names (rows as a pose name or literal rows, segments, integer dx/dy, hidden, mirror). Clips and render_pixelspec address a frame by name or by index, so name is optional.

pixelspec_v1.description: PixelSpec (roadmap 4.5): pixel art as editable text, rendered with numpy only by codeart_core.render_pixelspec, which reads this shape. schema is codeart2d.pixelspec.v1, the canonical id to write; codeart.pixelspec.v1 is the legacy alias used by roadmap 4.5 and the design prototype, still accepted. Only schema, canvas, palette and layers are required: without frames the base layers render as one image. poses map names to pixelGrids that layers and frames reference by name. The outline (mode defaults to none) is drawn after compositing with 4-neighbourhood rules, so it needs a 1 px margin; solid and selout outlines name a palette character in color, and selout maps fill characters to outline characters in map. Not expressible here and refused by the renderer: pixels outside the canvas, characters missing from the palette, unknown pose, layer or frame names, duplicate layer names and variant keys missing from the palette. name, anchor_px and clips are not read by render_pixelspec: name labels the asset, anchor_px is the canvas root that the exported clips manifest carries, and clips (sprite clipSpec, frames by name or index) drive the sheet and clips exporters.

easing.description: Easing: linear, sine, in, out, step, cubic-bezier(a,b,c,d) or spring(k,d).

boneTrack.description: Keyframes for one bone as [t, value] pairs with t in [0, 1]: rotate in degrees about the bone pivot, translate [dx, dy], scale (uniform or [sx, sy]), show, and swap to a slot variant.

rigClip.description: One rig clip: frames samples at t = i/frames for loops and t = i/(frames-1) for one-shots. events use normalised t. ik maps chain names to two-bone IK chains; grounded keeps the rig on its ground line; entry_frame, transitions and role follow the sprite clipSpec.

rig_anim_v1.description: Rig animation (roadmap 4.8) for rig_animate.py: clips that pose the bones of an SVG rig (bones are <g id data-pivot>, slots carry data-z). states maps state names to clips; entry_reference names the clip whose first pose is the rest pose for entry frames; pixel sets the pixel route's ramps (five colours, or hi/mid/lo/dark/out with mid required), light direction, inner lines and outline.

fx_v1.description: Gameplay-timed effects for fx_build.py and the fx.v1 runtime: a runtime spawns an effect at hitAt - impactMs. seeds make particles deterministic. canvas and origin place the effects; frameMs sets the frame grid an effect is rendered on, outline names its outline colour and events are its own timed events. The six fx_build presets (slash, sparks, ring, flash, dust, projectile) are closed: fx_build refuses unknown parameters. Other primitive types stay open for hand-written runtimes.

codeart_meta_v1.description: codeart-meta.json beside every codeart2d output. art_source is always code (disclose it as code-drawn, no image model; codeart_core writes that text in disclosure); spec_sha256 binds the outputs to the exact text spec; qa is a QA envelope over the outputs (codeart_core wraps qa_pixels metrics in one). renderer names the tool and version, and for SVG art the codeart_core.rasterize info: backend, engine, zoom and output size. palette is usually {colors, variants} as codeart_core.write_codeart_meta writes it: base colours by name and named variants that override some of them. placeholder is true for stand-in art (layout_build records it honestly). Tool details: pixelspec (render_pixelspec.py: the spec's name, schema id, canvas, anchor_px and outline mode; variants {label: folder}; frames [{index, name, file or null, empty?, reuses?}]; clips {manifest_schema, manifests, bundles, per_clip}; preview {file, scale, layout}), svg (svg_render.py render: mode vector or crisp, lint profile, zoom, canvas, anchor_px, palette_source, variants, images), route with rig and anim (rig_animate.py) or spec (fx_build.py) as fileRefs, renderer.route and for the pixel route renderer.coverage_ss, coverage and finish, and params and tilesets (autotile_build.py).

material_spec_v1.description: Materials for autotile_build.py: colour ramps (dark to light) per material, the tile sets to build (wang_corner takes two or three materials, blob47 exactly two, bevel and flat one), interior-only variants and a fixed seed. A material may be walkable or not (tileset collision at collision_cell resolution), carry edge and shadow bands (materialBandRule), bevel offsets per side and a texture: a base ramp position, periodic noise levels [threshold, amplitude, ramp position], marks of ramp positions ('.' or space is empty) with weights and a count per tile, or an image. A set may carry its id, plateau, wobble and margin.

doctor_report_v1.description: svg_render.py doctor --report: codeart_core.run_doctor output (cases, backends, primary, lint, hint?) extended into a common QA envelope, plus the platform. status is pass only when the primary backend passes every case and the portable lint rejects every lint case; deviations of fallback backends are warn checks. svg_render writes no schema key yet; codeart2d.doctor_report.v1 is the id to use when one is added.

ikGait.description: Planted-foot gait for a loop clip with stride_world_units: the foot is planted for the stance fraction of the cycle and travels stride * stance against the body, so it stays still in the world; during the swing it lifts by lift px and rolls by roll degrees. phase offsets the cycle (0..1) and x the foot's rest x.

ikChain.description: Two-bone IK: bones [root, middle]; end is a child bone of middle (its pivot is the effector) or a rest point [x, y]; pole is the direction the middle joint bends toward; exactly one of target (keyframes of canvas points) or gait; angle keys the end bone's world angle; ground (default true) keeps the end bone's slots on the rig ground line.

rig_report_v1.description: rig-report.json written by rig_animate.py: per-clip frame records (QA metrics, ground edge, margin, IK contacts), seam reports, planted-foot drift, entry frame, stride and events, all in output pixels; qa is the envelope of codeart-meta.json.

fx_slash.description: fx_build.py slash preset (closed: fx_build refuses unknown parameters). ramp names a ramp of the spec, colors list palette colours; impact as a time means the effect's impactMs.

fx_sparks.description: fx_build.py sparks preset (closed: fx_build refuses unknown parameters). ramp names a ramp of the spec, colors list palette colours; impact as a time means the effect's impactMs.

fx_ring.description: fx_build.py ring preset (closed: fx_build refuses unknown parameters). ramp names a ramp of the spec, colors list palette colours; impact as a time means the effect's impactMs.

fx_flash.description: fx_build.py flash preset (closed: fx_build refuses unknown parameters). ramp names a ramp of the spec, colors list palette colours; impact as a time means the effect's impactMs.

fx_dust.description: fx_build.py dust preset (closed: fx_build refuses unknown parameters). ramp names a ramp of the spec, colors list palette colours; impact as a time means the effect's impactMs.

fx_projectile.description: fx_build.py projectile preset (closed: fx_build refuses unknown parameters). ramp names a ramp of the spec, colors list palette colours; impact as a time means the effect's impactMs.

fx_report_v1.description: fx-report.json written by fx_build.py: per effect the frames (start, duration and sample ms, QA metrics, margin), durations, hit frame, dropped tail frames, events and loop seam; slash arc progress per frame; the build and runtime records; qa is the envelope of codeart-meta.json. fx-verify.json is a common qaEnvelope plus effects and findings.

materialBandRule.description: An edge or shadow band of an autotile material: colors are ramp positions (integers) or explicit colours, applied in order from the boundary inward; against and from limit the rule to boundaries with or from the named materials.

layout_spec_v1.description: Input of layout_build.py. size is in tiles; terrain shapes use tile (vertex) coordinates and paint in order; objects, spawns, interactions, scatter regions and clearances are world pixels.

parallax_spec_v1.description: Input of parallax_build.py: viewport and camera envelope as in parallax_plan, and layers back to front. Generated kinds (sky, ridge, clouds, foreground) are periodic in their period; image layers bring their own PNG.

plate_effects_v1.description: Input of ambient_bake.py: effects in feathered polygons of a static plate. Every effect period must divide the loop period_ms (default: their least common multiple).

ambient_loop_v1.description: ambient-loop.json from ambient_bake.py: a cycle loop of frame_count PNG frames lasting period_ms; durations_ms sum to period_ms; frame N would equal frame 0. art_source is code only when the plate itself is code art (plate_art_source records the plate's, motion_source the motion's).
